players.product: MRSI high-precision die bonders for packaging optical components into transceivers (Global Technologies division)

quarterly_data.quarter: Mycronic press release: Mycronic receives order for an SLX mask writer (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Order (release): Mycronic received an order for an SLX laser mask writer from an existing customer, for delivery to Europe, worth USD 5-7 million, with delivery planned for the third quarter of 2027; the customer chose the SLX to phase out an older mask writer. The company says photomasks made by laser mask writers account for a majority of all photomasks produced for semiconductor manufacturing.
quarterly_data.figure: order value USD 5-7 million; delivery planned for the third quarter of 2027
